result:
I’d make it so every person could reliably tell when information is true, false, or uncertain—*instantly and at the point of decision*, not after the fact.

Concretely: any claim (news, statistics, videos, quotes, scientific results, political promises) would carry a clear, standardized “confidence” label based on transparent sourcing and independent verification, with incentives for corrections. It wouldn’t remove disagreement or complexity, but it would sharply reduce misinformation, scams, and manipulative propaganda—so people could focus their energy on solving real problems instead of arguing over fabricated reality.
